events.title: National Museum of Iceland — Making of a Nation
events.blurb: Iceland's national history museum, open daily 10:00–17:00. Permanent exhibition 'Making of a Nation: Heritage and History in Iceland' plus current shows 'A Voyage in History – The Bridal Costume' and 'FLOW – Sólon Íslandus & Mógil' (both running through the window). Students/seniors 1600 ISK, under 18 free.

events.title: Perlan — Wonders of Iceland, Ice Cave & Áróra Planetarium
events.blurb: Nature exploratorium in the glass dome on Öskjuhlíð hill — exhibitions open daily 9:00–21:00. Walk through a real indoor ice cave, watch Áróra (8K northern-lights planetarium show), the Geldingadalir volcano show, the Látrabjarg bird-cliff model, and take in the 360° observation deck over Reykjavík.

events.title: Whales of Iceland
events.blurb: Europe's largest whale museum: 23 life-sized models of the whales found in Icelandic waters, with audio guide. Open daily 10:00–17:00; live guided tours daily at 11:00 and 15:00. Kids 7–15 2000 ISK, under 7 free.

events.title: Árbær Open Air Museum
events.blurb: Open-air museum of 20+ relocated historic houses forming a village, square and farm — costumed staff, old-time playground, exhibitions 'Growing Pains' and 'Ancient Roots of Árbær'. Summer hours daily 10:00–17:00 with an English guided tour of the houses daily at 13:00.

events.title: The Settlement Exhibition — Aðalstræti 10 & 16
events.blurb: Underground exhibition built around a 10th-century Viking longhouse ruin found in 2001, extending into Reykjavík's oldest house at Aðalstræti 10. Open daily 10:00–17:00; free guided tour in English weekdays at 11:00 (through 21 Aug) — runs Tue/Wed/Thu this window.

events.title: Reykjavík Maritime Museum + Coast Guard Vessel Óðinn
events.blurb: Harbourside museum with 'Fish & Folk – 150 Years of Fisheries' and 'A View of the North', plus floating exhibits. Open daily 10:00–17:00. Guided tours aboard the Cod Wars coast guard vessel Óðinn daily at 13:00, 14:00 and 15:00.

events.title: Erró: Remix & Karin Sander: 1957-2057 at Hafnarhús
events.blurb: The old harbour warehouse branch of Reykjavík Art Museum shows 'Erró: Remix — including a selection of Scapes' (the Icelandic pop-art giant) and German conceptual artist 'Karin Sander: 1957–2057'. Open 10:00–17:00, Thursday late night until 22:00 (Jul 30).

events.title: Kjarval and the 20th Century + Big Little City at Kjarvalsstaðir
events.blurb: Modernist pavilion on Klambratún park showing 'Kjarval and the 20th Century: When Modernity Anchored' (Iceland's beloved landscape painter Jóhannes Kjarval) and 'Big Little City – Reykjavík in View'. Open daily 10:00–17:00.

events.title: Ásmundur Sveinsson: Wonderland at Ásmundarsafn
events.blurb: Sculptor Ásmundur Sveinsson's domed studio-home and sculpture garden hosts 'Wonderland', 'Wonderland: Remnants' and an open workshop. Open daily 13:00–17:00; the surrounding sculpture garden is free anytime.

events.title: björk: echolalia + James Merry: Metamorphlings
events.blurb: The National Gallery on the Pond shows 'björk: echolalia' (31.5–20.9.2026) and 'James Merry: Metamorphlings' (31.5–18.10.2026) — Björk and her longtime creative collaborator side by side — plus the Treasures of Icelandic Art collection. Open every day 10:00–17:00.

events.title: Street Scenes — FÓKUS at Reykjavík Museum of Photography
events.blurb: Photography museum above the city library. Fresh exhibition 'Street Scenes' by the FÓKUS amateur photography club (opened 24 Jul) plus 'Heartstrings: intimacy in the everyday' by Þórdís Erla Ágústsdóttir. Open Mon–Thu 10:00–18:00.

events.title: Above Iceland (English subtitles) at Bíó Paradís
events.blurb: Icelandic film 'Above Iceland' screening with English subtitles at Reykjavík's beloved arthouse cinema. Tue 28 Jul at 16:40 (also Thu 30 Jul 16:40). Same-day English-subbed alternative: 'Sentimental Value' at 21:15.

events.title: Ástin sem eftir er / The Love That Remains (English subtitles) at Bíó Paradís
events.blurb: Hlynur Pálmason's acclaimed Icelandic feature 'Ástin sem eftir er' (The Love That Remains) with English subtitles, Wed 29 Jul at 16:40. Also Wed with ENG subs: Jafar Panahi's Cannes winner 'It Was Just an Accident' at 18:50.

events.title: Jörðin undir fótum okkar (English subtitles) at Bíó Paradís
events.blurb: Icelandic documentary 'Jörðin undir fótum okkar' (The Ground Beneath Our Feet) with English subtitles, Thu 30 Jul at 16:50. Also Thu with ENG subs: 'Sentimental Value' at 18:00 and 'Above Iceland' at 16:40.
